answer: Resist Sybils with stone-mason's lintel setting. At the jetty, a newcomer sets 14 lintels over 26 days. Two masons from different crews check each lintel's level within 24 hours and log every result on the site board. One lintel out of level by more than 4 millimeters voids that lintel's credit and halts work for 14 days; 2 bad lintels void the whole build. A faker running 1,000 agents would need 14,000 lintels and 28,000 crew checks in 26 days. Like a jetty wall that only stands where each stone was measured, trust holds level by level while a zephyr blows and honest agents wander in.
